title: With the Childlike People

teacherSummary.text: Siddhartha works for Kamaswami but treats business as a game, caring little for profit, which irritates the merchant yet makes Siddhartha successful. He watches ordinary people—the 'childlike people'—with amusement as they suffer over money and desire. Kamala teaches him the art of love, and they agree that neither of them can truly love.
